يلتبسون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَبِسُونَ (yaltabisūna) /jal.ta.bi.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# يُلْتَبَسُونَ (yultabasūna) /jul.ta.ba.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
